question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the attainment of the eight supernatural powers?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are included among the results described.
The attainment of these supernatural powers is identified as the root Kaula.
inference: Therefore, the attainment of the eight supernatural powers belongs to the essential teaching of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact list of the eight siddhis is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight supernatural powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
